name: cypress-project
description: Test automation project using Cypress framework

scripts.test:qauto: set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cypress run --config-file cypress.config.qauto.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js
scripts.test:qauto2: set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cypress run --config-file cypress.config.qauto2.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js
scripts.test:qauto:firefox: set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cypress run --browser firefox --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js
scripts.test:qauto2:firefox: set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cypress run --browser firefox --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto2.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js
scripts.test:firefox:confirm: set ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=&& cypress run --browser "%LOCALAPPDATA%\Mozilla Firefox 115 ESR\core\firefox.exe" --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto.js --spec cypress/e2e/firefox-launch-parameters.cy.js
scripts.test:docker:qauto:chrome: docker compose run --rm cypress-chrome npx cypress run --browser chrome --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js
scripts.test:docker:qauto2:chrome: docker compose run --rm cypress-chrome npx cypress run --browser chrome --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto2.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js
scripts.test:docker:firefox:confirm: docker compose run --rm cypress-firefox npx cypress run --browser firefox --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto.js --spec cypress/e2e/firefox-launch-parameters.cy.js --env dockerRun=true,runTarget=docker-firefox
scripts.docker:confirm:full: npm run docker:build:firefox && npm run test:docker:firefox:confirm && npm run postdocker:copy-screenshot
scripts.test:docker:qauto:firefox: docker compose run --rm cypress-firefox npx cypress run --browser firefox --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js --env dockerRun=true,runTarget=docker-firefox
scripts.test:docker:qauto2:firefox: docker compose run --rm cypress-firefox npx cypress run --browser firefox --headless --config-file cypress.config.qauto2.js --spec cypress/e2e/student-garage-expenses.cy.js --env dockerRun=true,runTarget=docker-firefox
scripts.test:all: npm run delete:reports && npm run test:qauto && npm run test:qauto2 && npm run merge:reports

author: IrynaFal
